invariants: Version 0.3.0 identifies the portable work-environment protocol and tooling release; it does not change the separately governed Rusty Morphospace platform or runtime baseline.
Existing v1 and v2 project events, receipts, and accepted state remain additive and are never rewritten by onboarding changes.
New scaffolds use raw revision-pinned schema URLs and remain inert until an exact resolved lock plus approved runtime input activates a feature.
Skill installation plans by default; Install never overwrites; Update requires explicit execution and creates a complete timestamped backup.
Installed skills bind their managed file hashes and exact local work-environment source state; verification fails on managed or provenance drift.
Contributor-local files are not managed and survive an update.
Strict environment validation rejects required placeholders, missing configured repos, Python below 3.11, and JDK below 17 for Quest profiles.
Quick, Standard, and Deep aggregate tiers preserve a single failed child as a failed run and never authorize device work.
The context skill routes to compact current project state and does not embed transient active-unit or release-candidate status.
Instruction-triggering units synchronize the nearest AGENTS, README/router, and relevant skill surfaces before acceptance.
